about.title: Informations
about.subtitle: About me
description: I am a Full Stack Web Developer specialized in designing and developing B2B SaaS platforms in production environments.
My approach combines the engineering of robust backend architectures with the creation of fluid, data-driven and accessible user interfaces.

I have over 2 years of commercial experience focused on Component-Driven Architecture, web performance optimization (SSR/ISR) and complex data flow management. Used to operating in fast-paced Agile (Scrum) teams, where software quality is ensured through Clean Code principles and constructive Code Reviews.
Open to international relocation and oriented toward continuous growth, with increasing interest in the DevOps world and large-scale software engineering practices.

experience.title: Experience
metriks_bullets: Built and maintained Dbiz, a B2B SaaS platform for business data analytics used by enterprise clients
Developed data-driven dashboards and Investor Relations portals with React, Next.js and TypeScript
Designed and implemented a headless CMS for corporate documents using Django REST Framework
Established CI/CD pipelines on Bitbucket with automated deploy to AWS, reducing release time
Containerized services with Docker and collaborated in Agile Scrum sprints with code reviews
Applied WCAG accessibility standards across all frontend interfaces
Worked in Agile Scrum environment with sprint planning, daily standups and retrospectives
giaogiao_bullets: Built responsive web and mobile interfaces for a digital ordering platform and self-service kiosk
Developed frontend with Vue.js, JavaScript, HTML5 and CSS in a fast-paced 3-person startup team
Delivered features end-to-end following Agile methodology with short iteration cycles

projects.title: Projects
projects.task_manager_desciption: A RESTful API for task management built with Node.js, Express and TypeScript. Features JWT authentication, full CRUD operations, input validation with Zod and PostgreSQL managed via Prisma ORM. Fully containerized with Docker.
projects.portfolio_v2_description: This very portfolio — built with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and next-intl for bilingual support. Features dark/light mode, SSG and a fully component-driven architecture.
projects.portfolio_v1_description: My first developer portfolio, built from scratch with vanilla HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Implemented a custom bilingual system (IT/EN) using data attributes before learning dedicated i18n libraries — the foundation that led to the Next.js version you're viewing now.
projects.flutter_description: A Human-Computer Interaction project exploring digital wellbeing — a hybrid focus app combining a distraction-blocking lock screen with music playback. Researched and adapted the implementation after discovering OS-level restrictions on screen-lock control, pivoting to a timer-based focus mode with emergency access preserved.
